about_the_game:
Mika's Battle S 3 is a 2D platform action game based on the story of Mika, one of the formidable warriors of the Sunshineland Army, who has been assigned the task of eliminating the intruders and the leader of the evil organization called Rogho Corporation in order to liberate the people of Rogholand from the oppressive government.



After successfully executing the rescue mission of Miss Sayuri, the leader of the Sunshineland Intelligence Department and who also happens to be Mika's mother, the Rogho Corporation increased their military activities, launching missiles around the North, West, and Southern border areas of the Sunshineland territory, while the Eastern border had already been taken care of by Mika. The enemy soldiers started to build more military bases inside the border area of the territory, killing the Sunshineland soldiers in the process. However, the civilians were already taken to the underground shelters, so there was no report of civilian casualties.

In order to cope with the situation, Mika, Shina, and later Ouka, the formidable Sunshineland super soldiers, had been sent to the border areas together to eliminate the intruders, destroy the enemy bases, and regain access to the Sunshineland Tech System, which was said to have been seized by the enemy soldiers, which compromised the security and integrity of the territory. Moreover, with the help of Sunshineland Intelligence, Mika and her group were able to successfully seize the secret underground port of the Rogho Corporation, which ultimately leads to the headquarters of the enemy. Soon after they reached ground level, they were met with heavy resistance from the enemy soldiers. 

You play as Mika, the Sunshineland warrior, and your ultimate goal is to eliminate the leader of the Rogho Corporation. Will you be able to accomplish your mission?



  • 15 Levels with stunning visuals!
  • Lots of enemy soldiers having different kinds of weapons!
  • 2 Boss Battles!
  • 3 Firing Modes which include machine gun, missile launcher and laser modes.
  • Lots of traps which include spikes, saws, laser beams etc.
  • Ability to double jump and collect items like health, ammo etc.
  • Join forces with Shina and Ouka to defeat the enemies.
  • Story driven. Anime aesthetics and lots of beautifully animated cutscenes!
  • Challenging situations and hard to master.
